{"action":"shell","command":"python3 - <<'PYEOF'\np='/testbed/HANDOFF.md'\ns=open(p).read()\nold='## Key assumptions (see spec.md A1-A11)'\nnew='## Key assumptions (see spec.md A1-A13)'\nassert old in s\ns=s.replace(old,new,1)\nold2='''- R07/R08 (entry expiry) are referenced by the round-2 R05 clarification but
  are NOT part of the current milestone input: no expiry behavior is specified
  or implemented yet. FR-019 constrains any future expiry state; re-run
  specify/plan when R07/R08 arrive.'''\nnew2='''- R07/R08 (entry expiry) are NOW specified (milestone 3): FR-022..FR-028,
  User Story 5, SC-009/SC-010, A12/A13; FR-019 is fully in scope (resize
  preserves absolute expiry). Implementation still pending in
  src/cachetools/tagged.py.'''\nassert old2 in s\ns=s.replace(old2,new2,1)\nold3='''## Next actions
- $speckit-tasks, then implement in src/cachetools/tagged.py with
  project-authored tests (tests/test_tagged.py); verify via
  `PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest acceptance_public.py tests/test_tagged.py
  tests/ -q` and the milestone falsification cases (empty 'all' removes 0;
  resize shrink evicts LRU only; generator consumed once; failed resize no-op).'''\nnew3='''## Next actions
- $speckit-plan/$speckit-tasks, then implement R01-R08 in
  src/cachetools/tagged.py with project-authored tests (tests/test_tagged.py);
  verify via `PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest acceptance_public.py
  tests/test_tagged.py tests/ -q` and the milestone falsification cases
  (empty 'all' removes 0; resize shrink evicts LRU only and preserves
  absolute expiry; generator consumed once; failed resize no-op; TTL boundary
  inclusive; purge does not touch survivor recency; invalid ttl fail-fast).'''\nassert old3 in s\ns=s.replace(old3,new3,1)\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nprint('ok handoff updated')\nPYEOF"}
